title: Layered architecture
body: Architecture uses layered components and explicit boundaries. Retrieval uses a compact local index.

attributes.interpretation: Architecture uses layered components and explicit boundaries.

title: Layered retrieval design
body: In the layered architecture, retrieval combines lexical matching with a compact local index for bounded discovery.

attributes.interpretation: In the layered architecture, retrieval combines lexical matching with a compact local index for bounded discovery.

title: Layered supported tasks
body: The layered architecture supports tasks including comparison, summarization, and traceable question answering.

attributes.interpretation: The layered architecture supports tasks including comparison, summarization, and traceable question answering.

title: Distributed architecture
body: The distributed architecture separates ingestion, storage, and query execution while keeping evidence immutable.

attributes.interpretation: The distributed architecture separates ingestion, storage, and query execution while keeping evidence immutable.

title: Distributed filtered retrieval
body: In the distributed architecture, retrieval applies source filters before ranking and returns bounded excerpts for review.

attributes.interpretation: In the distributed architecture, retrieval applies source filters before ranking and returns bounded excerpts for review.

title: Distributed operational tasks
body: The distributed architecture supports tasks including monitoring, classification, and concise evidence-backed reporting.
